audience: domain owners and admins who host their DNS on deSEC

useCases.title: See all DNS records of a domain
useCases.text: The AI lists the records of a domain as RRsets, filtered by type or subname, and opens one set such as the MX records of the apex.

useCases.title: List your domains and when they last changed
useCases.text: The AI lists the domains (zones) in your account with creation time, last-published time and minimum TTL.

useCases.title: Get the DNSSEC records to publish at your registrar
useCases.text: The AI reads a domain's DNSKEY and DS records, which you publish at the registrar for the chain of trust.

useCases.title: Back up a zone before you change records
useCases.text: The AI exports the whole zone as a BIND-format zonefile, so you keep a copy of all records except the DNSSEC ones.

useCases.title: Create or replace a DNS record set
useCases.text: The AI creates a new RRset or replaces all records of an existing one with a TTL and values you give. It goes live at once, so check the values first.
